title: Efficiently Approximating Attention Is Hard
abstract: arXiv:2609.37261v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Softmax attention is ubiquitous in modern machine learning, but its quadratic scaling with sequence length makes it costly. To reduce this cost, attention is often approximated with fast algorithms, which incur error but can still perform well in practice and on some inputs. At the same time, the growing diversity of attention applications makes approximation guarantees that do not depend on particular input structure a compelling target. For such uniform guarantees over all inputs, known runtime lower bounds rule out fast algorithms for near-exact attention, but leave open the practically important regime: is there an efficient algorithm with even a modest uniform approximation guarantee? We answer this question negatively. Under standard complexity-theoretic assumptions, no truly subquadratic algorithm can approximate attention with any nontrivial additive or relative guarantee uniformly over all inputs. translated_title: 高效近似注意力是困难的
translated_abstract: Softmax注意力在现代机器学习中无处不在，但其随序列长度的二次方扩展使其代价高昂。为了降低这一成本，人们常用快速算法来近似注意力，这些算法会引入误差，但在实践中以及某些输入上仍能有良好表现。与此同时，注意力应用的日益多样化，使得不依赖特定输入结构的近似保证成为一个极具吸引力的目标。对于这种覆盖所有输入的一致保证，已知的运行时间下界已经排除了近精确注意力的快速算法，但仍留下一个在实践中十分重要的未解问题：是否存在一种高效算法，能够提供哪怕适度的一致近似保证？我们对这一问题给出了否定的回答。在标准的复杂性理论假设下，不存在任何真正亚二次方时间的算法，能够在所有输入上一致地以任何非平凡的加性或相对保证来近似注意力。这种不可能性在……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明了在标准复杂性理论假设下，不存在真正亚二次方时间的算法能在所有输入上一致地以任何非平凡的加性或相对保证近似注意力，从而否定了存在具有适度一致近似保证的高效注意力算法的可能性。
en_tdlr: Under standard complexity-theoretic assumptions, no truly subquadratic algorithm can uniformly approximate attention over all inputs with any nontrivial additive or relative guarantee, ruling out efficient attention approximation even with modest uniform guarantees.
